description: This Java source file defines a specific implementation of a loan repayment schedule transaction processor, handling complex logic for different types of loan payments (advance, late, normal, refunds). It manages the allocation of payments to penalty charges, interest, principal, and fees according to specified rules.

classes.name: DuePenIntPriFeeInAdvancePenIntPriFeeLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A loan repayment schedule transaction processor handling payments that cover penalty, interest, principal, and fee components in a specific order, including in advance penalties and fees.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles early/in advance loan payments, allocating amounts to penalty, interest, principal, and fee components according to the in-advance logic.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayment transactions, delegating to the on-time payment handler in this implementation.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles on-time loan payments, allocating received amount to penalty, interest, principal, and fee components.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refund payments, unallocating amounts from principal, interest, fee, and penalty components in reverse order.
